decision: Adopted37-word camera-and-reading passage, two compact notes; prior narrative and images preserved. Source and affected rendered layouts separately reviewed. No publication.
proposed_public_paragraph: Cinematographer Rudrakanta Singh recalled shooting a short film in Koraput with a Canon 600D, a single lens and bounce boards to redirect light.[^rudra-camera] His practice also leaves room for reading and watching. In a 2024 profile, he named films by Akira Kurosawa and Satyajit Ray among his holiday viewing and said he was reading Kalpana Kumari Devi’s Achinha Basabhumi.[^rudra-reading] These are different kinds of attention a working cinematographer makes time for.
